name: Nightfall
tagline: Dark, image-led photography portfolio: full-bleed plates, quiet serif, gold.
longDescription:
Nightfall is a portfolio theme for photographers and visual artists who want the work to do the talking. Pages sit on a warm darkroom black so photographs glow the way they do on a lightbox, and a single safelight-gold accent marks the few things that matter: an index number, a button, one italic line in the footer.

The home page opens on a full-bleed photograph with a vertical plate caption, then moves through a short statement, a staggered 12-column gallery with numbered captions, numbers, commissions, a testimonial, journal entries and a photographic call to action. Type is minimal: Cormorant Garamond Light for headlines and Manrope for small, widely tracked labels.

Included: 14 components (header with an overlay variant, footer, full-bleed and portrait-split heroes, statement, staggered gallery, project index, commissions, numbers, testimonial, call to action, contact block, clients and journal card) and six page templates (home, about, work, journal, contact and a 404), with copy for an invented photographer and seven original photographs. Every grid collapses to one column on phones.
